title: Chicken Sausage Breakfast Burrito
description: This easy high-protein breakfast burrito combines egg whites, Amylu chicken sausage, reduced-fat cheddar, and guacamole in a Mission Carb Balance tortilla for approximately 42 grams of protein and 375 calories.
image_prompt: A realistic breakfast burrito on a clean neutral plate, slightly open to show fluffy scrambled egg whites, browned sliced chicken breakfast sausage, melted cheddar, and creamy guacamole. Soft flour tortilla, realistic home-cooked portion, warm natural light, appetizing but not overstyled. No salsa, beans, whole eggs, potatoes, or other unlisted ingredients.
image_alt_text: High-protein chicken sausage breakfast burrito with egg whites, cheddar, and guacamole.
